bio.text: Chris Reichard, an Army veteran, is the Democratic candidate for Missouri's 8th Congressional District, facing Republican Rep. Jason Smith in the November 2026 general election.
He told KRCU he joined the Army after graduating high school in 2003 and served three tours, including in Iraq.
After living in Texas for a few years he returned to Missouri, where he grew up, and he currently works as a communications journeyman technician, according to KRCU.

sources.title: Dem Chris Reichard Wins Aug 4th Primary; Moves to Challenge Incumbent Jason Smith for House of Representatives
